name: doc-call-to-action
purpose: The closing offer of a documentation page, parked at the foot of the "On this page" rail after the outline. It is a docs card built like every other card on the page: a `RegistrationFrame` with corner marks, a flat `--bg-surface` face, the wordmark at its small size, a headline, a subtitle and full-width stacked actions. Set on the rail scale (14 px headline, 12 px copy) so it never out-shouts the page outline. Every string is content passed by the page. Its actions are `{ label, href }` objects, the same shape as the marketing bands' `primaryAction` / `secondaryAction`.
useWhen: Use DocCallToAction only in the docs 'On this page' rail; marketing bands use CallToAction.
Once per documentation page, last in the right rail.
avoidWhen: In the prose column — use `CallToAction` on marketing pages or a `DocCard` link in docs.
bestPractices: One primary action; a secondary only when it is a real alternative (talk to sales).
A one-line headline and a one-line subtitle.

props.name: title
props.doc: The offer's headline; names the complementary landmark.

props.name: label
props.doc: Fallback copy when the default slot is empty.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: The primary action, `{ label, href }`; unset or an empty label renders none.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: The outlined secondary action, `{ label, href }`; unset renders none.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The offer's copy, set as the headline's subtitle.
